rules.rationale: The exact For-to-#loop rewrite and guard are first proved by SHAPE-CONNECTION-SPEC.for-list-shape against SHAPE-CONNECTION, which imports ROW-MODEL and not VERIFICATION; prove.sh runs that #Top proof before compiling the verification module containing this reusable priority rule.
This is the empty-sequence base equation defining advanceIndex.
This is the structurally recursive cons equation defining advanceIndex by incrementing the index once per element.
This is the empty-sequence base equation defining the scanAppend summary.
This simplification rule is the guarded matching-element recurrence of scanAppend: it appends the current coordinate and recurses on the tail.
This simplification rule is the complementary nonmatching-element recurrence of scanAppend and recurses on the tail without appending.
This is the empty-row-sequence base equation defining the rowsAppend summary.
This simplification rule is the guarded recursive rowsAppend equation, defining one row through scanAppend before descending to the remaining rows.
This macro-expansion equation defines INNERBODY as the exact inner-loop statement constructors.
This macro-expansion equation defines OUTERBODY as the exact outer-loop statement constructors.
This macro-expansion equation defines GETROWBODY as the exact target-function statement constructors.
This macro-expansion equation defines COLUMNCLOSURE as the named proof term for the supplied column-key closure.
This macro-expansion equation defines ROWCLOSURE as the named proof term for the supplied row-key closure.
